text:
#!name=微博&微博国际版净化
#!desc=墨鱼手记出品的 Quantumult X 重写 · 来源 墨鱼手记
#!author=@ddgksf2013

[MITM]
hostname = api.weibo.*, *.api.weibo.*, mapi.weibo.*, *.uve.weibo.com, new.vip.weibo.cn, boot.biz.weibo.com

[Rewrite]
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/statuses\/container_positive - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/push\/info - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/.*account\/recommend_interesttags - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/.*\/media_homelist - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/.*finder\/searchbarchange - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/ad\/preload - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/profile\/recommend_popuser - reject
^https?:\/\/boot.*weibo\.com\/v\d\/ad\/realtime - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/.*discovery_home_bottom_getdotinfo - reject
^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d/push/daily - reject
^https?:\/\/(preload-click|preload-impression)\.uve\.weibo\.com\/(interface\/wbpullad\/wbpullad_click\.php|wbapplua\/get_wbpullad_log\.lua) - reject
^https?:\/\/sdkapp\.uve\.weibo\.com\/interface\/sdk\/sdkconfig\.php - reject
^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/hot\/hours_spotlight - reject
^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/cardlist\?v_f=.*Weibo_intl - reject
^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/portal\.php\?a=hot_search_users - reject
^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/ad\/weibointl\? - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/statuses\/container_detail, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/groups\/allgroups\/v\d, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/boot.*weibo\.com\/v\d\/ad\/preload, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/\w{5}\/(statuses_unread_hot_timeline|timeline), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/\d\/video\/tiny_stream_mid_detail, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/\w{5}\/cardlist, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://api.weibo.cn/2/!/client/light_skin, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://new.vip.weibo.cn/littleskin/preview, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/(searchall|page\?|0flowpage), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/statuses/(unread_)?friends(/|_)timeline, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/groups/timeline, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/statuses/(container_timeline|unread_hot_timeline|extend|video_mixtimeline|unread_topic_timeline), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/profile/(me|container_timeline), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/video/(community_tab|remind_info|tiny_stream_video_list), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/search/(finder|container_timeline|container_discover), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/(checkin/show|\!/live/media_homelist|container/get_item), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/m?api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/\d\/cardlist, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.cn\/portal\.php\?a=open_app, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/portal\.php.*a=get_searching_info, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_search_info.json, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/portal\.php.*feed&a=search_topic, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_search_topic.json, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/portal\.php.*get_coopen_ads, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?://(sdk|wb)app\.uve\.weibo\.com(/interface/sdk/sdkad.php|/wbapplua/wbpullad.lua), script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.c(n|om)\/portal\.php.*a=trends, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.cn\/portal\.php\?a=user_center, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/weibointl\.api\.weibo\.cn\/portal\.php\?a=search_topic, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/weibo_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
